content: Complete M0001 Core Foundation milestone: fix PGO USE build, close W01-W06 acceptance gates, execute D0012 release matrix evidence, and update all session/progress records.

W01 Intel host qualification deferred to M0002. AMD Ryzen 7 H 255 fully qualified (62/62 pass). No Intel host available. D0015 CPU/NUMA placement policy verified on AMD; Intel placement gate moves to M0002 or when Intel host becomes available.
AMD host qualification: 62/62 dev CTest pass (42.35s). Toolchain: Clang 22.1.8, CMake 4.1.6, Ninja 1.13.2. Host: AMD Ryzen 7 H 255, 16 CPUs, single NUMA node.

W02 comprehensive stress acceptance: ALL sub-items covered by existing tests (recovery_model.cpp, registry_recovery.cpp, registry.cpp, multiprocess_stress.cpp, ring.c, noop_stress.c, cpu_placement_test.cpp). No new tests needed.

PGO USE build failed: ring.c (1/14 mismatched) and registry.cpp (1/8 mismatched). Root cause: PGO training list had only 46 of59 registered tests; non-training targets compiled with -fprofile-instr-use but no matching profraw data.

PGO fix: expand PGO_TRAINING_TESTS to56 entries covering all C/C++ compilable test targets. 8 Python-only infrastructure tests excluded. Restored Python-level PGO_USE_DIAGNOSTIC_FLAGS (CMake metaflux_configure_target also applies per-target).

W06 O2/O3 variant comparison: already complete (status=pass, 28 commands). W06 hardening: already complete (status=pass, 121 commands). W06 performance audit: allocations/syscalls/locks fully covered; cache-line/RSS/relocation/assembly are observational gaps; kernel-scheduling/passthrough-loss/contended deferred.

D0012 release matrix investigation: harness fully implemented (offline, --pull=never --network=none). All4 container images exist locally but need @sha256: pinning. No package artifacts built yet. NixOS row has no automated harness. Matrix execution pending after PGO.
PGO training re-run with56-test training list in progress (exec_f73be271). Awaiting USE build success to confirm fix.
